newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh imports 132,250 tonnes of wheat.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh imports 132,250 tonnes of wheat.

text.p: Bangladesh has awarded Mitsui & Co a deal for importing 32,250 tonnes of soft red U.S. wheat at 27,000 yen ($226.81) CIF per tonne for shipment by February 24, food ministry officials said on Wednesday. Bangladesh is buying the wheat under a 850 million yen Japanese grant. The bidding took place on January 25.

In another bidding for 100,000 tonnes of hard red winter/srping wheat of Australian, Swedish or Dutch origin held last month U.S. company Romak Ltd won a contract for supplying 75,000 tonnes at a rate of CIF $187.79 and Glencore Ltd of the Netherlands 25,000 tonnes at $187.95.
